user.title: MY Local Devices Tuya
user.description: Connect to the MY Local Devices Tuya add-on. The add-on URL is detected from Supervisor automatically. Leave it blank unless you run the web app elsewhere.

error.addon_not_found: Add-on not found. Install and start MY Local Devices Tuya first.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on. Check that it is running and the URL/credentials are correct.
error.auth_required: The add-on is in ingress-only mode. Set AUTH_USERNAME and AUTH_PASSWORD in the add-on options, then enter the same credentials here.
